method.styles: Compared each route’s stylesheet/font link tags to Book 1 Chapter 1.
method.controls: Native details/summary markup was counted and balanced; live browser clicking was unavailable.
method.translation: Every card has a nonempty English paragraph. Listed filler/inaccurate cases were corrected; other English translations were not semantically certified.
method.transliteration: Generated IAST from displayed Devanāgarī and compared it with the main transliteration after spacing/punctuation normalization. Tri-gram similarity is a screening aid, not source validation.
limitations: No complete source-witness review of all 6,400 cards.
A mismatch can indicate wrong IAST, Sanskrit segmentation, a textual variant, or source-text corruption.
